scope.description: The repository path glob, team or project that the claim applies to. Required for a loose entry.

sourceSession.description: A session id from the harness, to trace the claim to a run.

supersedesId.description: The entry that this entry replaces.

distinct.description: Send true to say that the entry is different from the similar entries that the server found.

standing.description: Send true to start the entry as STANDING. The server ignores it for an agent.

items.description: One citation. Give one target only: a file (path with lines), an issue, a pullRequest, a comment, a run, or a url with a quote.

path.description: A file path from the repository root.

lines.description: The cited lines, for example "40-52". Required with path.

sha.description: The commit. If you omit it, the server uses the head of the default branch.

repo.description: The full name of the repository. Send it when the path alone does not identify the repository.

quote.description: Text that the cited lines or page must contain. Required with url.

pullRequest.description: The URL of a pull request that has a link to an issue.

items.title: PageEntryCitationInputDto
